title: Password Reset Not Working
description: Fix lost-password emails that never arrive, invalid reset links, or expired reset keys.

steps.title: Check Spam and Email Delivery
steps.instructions: Search spam/junk folders. Send a test email from an SMTP plugin or host mail log to confirm outbound mail works at all.

steps.title: Configure SMTP or Transactional Email
steps.instructions: Install and configure WP Mail SMTP, Post SMTP, or host-provided SMTP. PHP mail() alone is unreliable on most hosts.

steps.title: Fix From Address and Domain Authentication
steps.instructions: Use a From address on your domain with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records. Mismatched From domains cause providers to drop password reset mail.

steps.title: Verify Reset Link URL
steps.instructions: Ensure siteurl/home match the URL users visit. Wrong domain in reset links (staging vs production) makes keys appear invalid.

steps.title: Check Security Plugin Email Blocks
steps.instructions: Some security plugins throttle or block password reset requests. Review rate limits and temporarily relax rules for testing.

steps.title: Provide Manual Reset as Fallback
steps.instructions: Reset the password via WP-CLI or database while fixing email. Document the SMTP fix so future resets work without agency intervention.

steps.title: Test Full Reset Flow
steps.instructions: Request a reset from wp-login.php?action=lostpassword. Confirm email arrives within minutes and the link successfully changes the password.
